issue_request: Published/Persuasive with Modification STU3 issue asking to clarify the apparent overlap between Task and Procedure by explaining that Task is a workflow step, Procedure is an action intended to cause a physical or mental change to or for the subject, and Task can request fulfillment of a ServiceRequest ordering a Procedure.
initial_application: Procedure-side text was applied in commit ef05a01a0bea. The corresponding Task-side text was applied through FHIR-19109/GF#19109 in commit d9208736f5.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively lists procedure, servicerequest, and task. Current Procedure and Task introductions both carry the requested distinction, ServiceRequest has related request-versus-Task guidance, and the cited Zulip thread supports the same interpretation. No Confluence reference specific to FHIR-17359 or conflicting community decision was found.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because no current source edit is needed; the approved implementer guidance is already present with only harmless wording/refactoring differences.
